title: An audit FAIL whose only defects are in the explanation document is classed code-audit-fail and restarts the correction at TDD
summary: Cycle 1745 (wave 30, 2026-09-29): the auditor found the code correct (14/14 predicates, 50/50 and 30/30 mutants killed, ACS suite green) and failed the cycle only because the explanation document had two factual errors (NEEDS_CORRECTION, as the explanation-review rule requires). The verdict's failure class was code-audit-fail with both defects naming docs/explain/builds/cycle-1745-*.md, the continuation found no audit-fail-reason.json ('findings artifact ... unreadable'), and the correction round restarted at TDD. The TDD re-dispatch then wedged its claude-tmux pane (exit 81, submit_wedged) before falling back to claude-p. A correction whose every defect is in the Build's own explanation document needs only the Build explanation re-author rung.
fix: Derive the correction's start phase from the defects, not the class label: when every defect path is the cycle's own explanation document (explanationdocs.DocumentPath), class the failure explanation-needs-correction and route the correction to the Build explanation re-author (the rung a byte-identical rebase already uses), skipping TDD and the code build. Write audit-fail-reason.json for this class too, so the continuation reads the findings.
acceptance: An audit FAIL whose defects all name the cycle's explanation document re-dispatches only the Build explanation re-author, not TDD (red today: cycle 1745 restarted at TDD)
A FAIL with any defect outside the explanation document keeps today's routing
The continuation reads the findings artifact for a doc-only FAIL (no 'findings artifact unreadable' WARN)
consumed_by: console landing fix/doc-only-audit-fail-reauthors (2026-09-29): BUILT. The correction's start phase comes from the defects: explanationCorrectionDocument (go/internal/core/explanation_correction.go) locates each failure-block defect by its first path-like token and classes the FAIL explanation-needs-correction when every location is the cycle's own explanationdocs.DocumentPath and no runner gate diagnosed it (CycleState.AuditFailReasons empty). decideAfterAuditFail (via auditFailEnvelope) narrows a granted envelope to retry@explanation or decline; retry@explanation re-enters Build, the rung that already re-authors the explanation after an unproven rebase (ADR-0105), so TDD is skipped, the code-audit-fail budget still bounds the round and an adjudicator's retry@tdd is clamped. Choosing it writes the defects, class-prefixed, into audit-fail-reason.json (recordExplanationCorrection; retired at the next audit dispatch), so the brief and a continuation read them and the unreadable WARN is gone for this class. seedAuditRepairContext adds CtxKeyExplanationReauthor to the round's Build dispatch on both dispatch roots; the build prompt's Explanation Re-author section says edit only the document, rewrite build-report.md (the rewrite completes the dispatch) and leave code and tests unchanged; the audit re-runs. A FAIL with any defect outside the document keeps today's routing. The auditor reference asks each explanation defect to begin with the document's path (pinned). The failurelog vocabulary and the auditor's declared class are unchanged; X2 (no FAIL at all) stays designed. Design: logic-first-delivery-design.md §5.14 (X2a).
